entries.zh: 约定；以言辞商定、约好
entries.en: to arrange, agree by word; covenant, settle (a matter) verbally

entries.zh: 约定；许诺（口语呼读之约）
entries.en: to promise, agree; pact by word of mouth
entries.notes: source_M 为呼读变体（yǎge），第二义依据词头同义并存推断。

entries.zh: 断定；裁定、商定（某事或某处所）
entries.en: to decide, settle definitively; fix (as a place or matter)
entries.notes: 西语栏文字残损（concertar ut el que lugar），义项据汉字「断」与语境推断。

entries.zh: 商量衡量；约量、斟酌定夺
entries.en: to measure, weigh; settle after reckoning, estimate

entries.zh: 缔交和好；托付、委托（办事）
entries.en: to make friendship, become reconciled; to entrust, commission

entries.zh: 密谋；暗中合计（计谋）
entries.en: to conspire secretly, plot together (a scheme)

entries.zh: 讲价；议定价钱、商定价格
entries.en: to bargain, agree on a price

entries.zh: 缚定；议定一定之约（定死、确定不移）
entries.en: to bind fixed, settle definitively (a fixed agreement or hire)
entries.notes: 西语栏缩写（mt′ concier′ fijo）展开依赖推断，义为『议定一定之约，固定下来』。

entries.zh: 缚做长年；订约雇为长工（按年佣雇）
entries.en: to contract as a yearly hired servant, bind for annual service
entries.notes: 闽南语原稿第三音节 tone_marks 标 T99（污損難辨），「長」字音写存疑。

entries.zh: 缚戏；约定联合演戏（合凑做戏）
entries.en: to contract jointly for a theatrical performance, band together for a play
entries.notes: 西语栏残损（come diante… por juntos），「缚戏」义据前条模式推断为合股约做戏。

entries.zh: 诈谋；设诡计图谋、合谋骗人
entries.en: to plot deceitfully, scheme to deceive; contrive fraud

entries.zh: 相处；彼此相合、和睦共处
entries.en: to get along together, agree with one another, live in harmony

entries.zh: 处准；处置准许、应允定妥
entries.en: to settle and approve, grant consent; aslindar: to fix, determine

entries.zh: 处顾；相顾照应、互相契合（相好相顾）
entries.en: to look after one another, be mutually agreed or accorded
entries.notes: 西语栏 asogulto 为疑难词形，「相顾」之义主要依汉字与对音，存疑。

entries.zh: 约束；彼此约束、立约受制
entries.en: to bind oneself, be bound by agreement; be settled, covenanted

entries.zh: 断约；言定立约（口断为约）
entries.en: to settle by word, agree verbally; to covenant

entries.zh: 通谋；串通合谋
entries.en: to conspire together, combine in a plot
entries.notes: 西语栏 venivanell/adunarse 为疑难词形（疑为 17c 拼写变体），义依汉字「通谋」与同条 18。

entries.zh: 同谋；共同合谋、串同一气
entries.en: to plot together, be accomplices; to conspire jointly

entries.zh: 监定；鉴定、勘定（评断定夺）
entries.en: to appraise, determine by inspection; settle as arbiter
entries.notes: 闽南语原稿音写无 tone_marks，监定义据汉字与西语 c′te yando（疑为 confiter/yando 系缩写）推断。

entries.zh: 齐整；收拾整齐、整治停当
entries.en: to put in order, arrange, compose; make neat and settled

entries.zh: 成就；事成办妥、商定办成
entries.en: to accomplish, bring to completion; settle (a matter) successfully

entries.zh: 相约；约在某家相会、互相邀约
entries.en: to arrange to meet, appoint (at any house); make an appointment with one another
entries.notes: 闽南语原稿「相」字记作 sia[g]，首音节 T99（污損難辨），音写残损。
